purpose: Speed and Reliability Foundation programme only: validation-cache, doctor-preflight, gatekeeper-replay, readiness-evidence.
revokeWhen: readiness-evidence is closed, or the owner withdraws it earlier. Revocation is a commit that removes this record or its entries AND reverts the matching --allowedTools entries in .projectops/project-config.json; with the record gone but the config still wider, the loop refuses to start any worker (fail closed) until the config is reverted too.
excludes: Every path that existed before this programme. In particular: projectos/validators/** except new files named validate-speed-*.cjs (validators run from the working tree with no build step, so the checks that judge the worker are never writable); projectos/agent/** except projectos/agent/test/replay/** (the loop, this grant's enforcement, the gatekeeper budget, the plan-authoring permission and the tests that pin them); projectos/core/**; projectos/control-center/**; projectos/scripts/**; projectos/security/**; projectos/host/**; projectos/credentials/**; projectos/session-router/**; projectos/forge/**.
.projectops/** other than the two worker-owned record grants that already exist: authority, plan, decision, closure, gate, ledger, evidence and credential records stay outside worker authority.

Every protected effect remains with the owner: production deployment, production or destructive database mutation, real messaging, payments, credential creation or disclosure, signing, service or ACL changes, force push, merge.
Commit, push and phase closure remain gated exactly as before; this grant changes what the worker may WRITE in the working tree, not what may be committed or closed.
trustBasis: MANUAL_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL, tamperProof false. This record has effect only when COMMITTED: the loop reads it from the repository's object store, never from the working tree, so a widening nobody approved is a visible diff at the owner's commit gate. Each entry must ALSO appear in the loop's own closed list WORKER_SOURCE_GRANTS; an entry outside that list is refused however it got here.
provenance: Transcribed by the implementer (Claude) from owner Murad's explicit approval of 2026-09-04 00:11: 'Approve the temporary restricted source-write grant for the Speed & Reliability programme. Keep all authority, gatekeeper, credential, closure, owner-gate, host, security, Forge and .projectops areas protected.' The implementer wrote these bytes; the implementer did not grant this authority and cannot.
reviewNote: Narrowed on 2026-09-04 after ECC security review of the first draft: subtree grants over projectos/validators, agent, core, control-center, scripts and docs were refused as self-referential (validators run from the working tree; agent, core and control-center hold the enforcement code).
